newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fox to spend A$150 mln on Sydney studios.
newsitem.headline: Fox to spend A$150 mln on Sydney studios.

text.p: News Corp Ltd's Fox Studios would invest over A$150 million to build a set of studios and production facilities at the former Showgrounds site in central Sydney, New South Wales Premier Bob Carr said on Tuesday.
"Their investment will be in excess of A$150 million," Carr told a news conference announcing the beginning of construction at the site.
Carr also announced that the movie "Babe 2", the sequel to the hit pig movie "Babe", would be shot at the studios between May and November this year.
"The producers expect some 500 people will be employed during the filming between May and November this year," Carr said.
Carr said the studios would generate about 1,600 jobs once fully operational and would employ about 1,000 workers during the construction phases.
The studios would include eight sound stages and various support facilities and be completed by early 1998.
"With projects of this quality, Sydney will cement its place as the film capital of the Asia Pacific," Carr said.
